'''Vajar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Ila]], he also shared his knowledge with other Sith.
